content:
The Comox Valley Regional District (CVRD) is a local government body responsible for the administration and delivery of various services to residents in the Comox Valley region of British Columbia, Canada. The CVRD was established in 2008 through the merging of the Comox-Strathcona Regional District and the Courtenay-Alberni Regional District.

The CVRD covers an area of approximately 2,400 square kilometers and includes the communities of Courtenay, Comox, Cumberland, and the surrounding rural areas. The regional district is governed by a board of directors made up of elected officials from member municipalities and electoral areas.

The CVRD provides a wide range of services to its residents, including solid waste management, regional planning, land use regulation, recreation facilities and programs, emergency services, and environmental stewardship. The regional district also works to foster economic development and promote sustainability in the region.

The CVRD is committed to engaging with its community members through public consultations, open houses, and other outreach initiatives. The regional district strives to create a healthy, vibrant, and inclusive community for all residents of the Comox Valley.
